page.layout: One column of running text at the top, a centred heading below it, then an italic paragraph running to the foot of the page. The catchword stands at the right under the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.p: dinatos esse Magistratui, ut & p.128. Et probat Augustini sententiam super hac re. Atque ex verbis citatis Theologorum Orthodoxorum patet, tum quomodo intelligi velint, quod dicunt ministros in Ecclesiasticis rebus subjectos esse Magistratui; nimirum non quoad substantiam officii, sed quoad exercitii directionem, ordinem externum & circumstantias: tum etiam ex parte apparet, quibus argumentis sententiam suam confirment. Ad objectiones Bellarm. respondent tum alii, tum Cl. Rivetus pag. 165.
main_text.head: Ad Quæst. duodecimam.

p.i: An non necesse sit explicari, quo modo ministri Ecclesiæ in rebus Ecclesiasticis pendeant à Magistratu, eique subjecti sint? Nam hoc ita generaliter & indefinitè positum facile in malam partem sumi posset. An non debebit ostendi, Ministros non pendere à Magistratu, ut servi pendent à dominis, aut ut ministri delegati à suis principibus, ut planum maneat, Pastores & ministros Ecclesiæ, non Magistratus, sed Dei & Christi ministros esse, quod D. page.notes: The first line of the page reads "dinatos esse Magistratui, ut & p.128." as printed; the "ut" of the first line is set close to "Magistratui,". "VValæus" is printed with a doubtful final letter; I read it as æ. The word "planum" is printed with an unusual initial letter that resembles a long s; I read it as "planum". The catchword "secun-" is printed with a hyphen and is kept as printed. The text is in a single column with no margin notes. The "Digitized by Google" stamp at the lower right is excluded.
